data.exact_reserve_text: Claims incurred in prior underwriting years 12,581

named_events.loss_description: significant increase in the level of claims activity due to storms in the South-eastern USA and Caribbean, compounded by two earthquakes in Mexico

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced a gross prior year reserve strengthening of GBP 12.581 million, representing 16.3% of opening reserves. This adverse development was primarily driven by natural catastrophe events, specifically the 'HIMM' losses (storms in the South-eastern USA and Caribbean and earthquakes in Mexico) which adversely impacted the claims ratio. The narrative also mentions a 'positive run off deviation' predominantly in Accident & Health business, which, despite the phrasing, aligns with the overall strengthening observed in the claims outstanding reconciliation.
raw_causal_phrases: The 2017 claims ratio has been adversely impacted by the storm and earthquake losses experienced in the third quarter
positive run off deviation of GBP 3,714k in the year, predominately in respect of Accident and Health business

significant increase in the level of claims activity, with claims incurred at GBP 109m compared to the GBP 68m incurred in 2016. The overriding factor in this has been the storms in the South-eastern USA and Caribbean in September 2017, compounded by two earthquakes occurring in Mexico, collectively referred to as the "HIMM" losses where the syndicate had exposure in the property, marine and contingency classes.

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: There is a discrepancy between the gross prior year development figure from the Claims Outstanding reconciliation table (GBP 12.581m strengthening) and the narrative text which states a 'positive run off deviation of GBP 3.714m' (implying a net release). The table figure is used as it is part of the formal reconciliation.
